cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Keep the spare cupboard key till tomorrow. Don't tell your flatmate I've left it here. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me what's in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Could you accept knowing what isn't? Nothing alive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Text me when she leaves work. Just 'key', please.

mechanism: A instructs temporary key custody, gives only a narrow reassurance and accepts B collection deadline while keeping the secret purpose withheld.
confusable: Unlike explaining the secret to obtain consent, A offers limited negative information; borrowed authority negotiates enough terms to retain B cooperation.
comparison: A flatmate key and a timed collection differ from an envelope leaving with a family member.
seedUse: D121-b cupboard key, nothing alive and coded collection text; S02-b accepts an alternative condition while maintaining the direction.
